title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Commercial Census - Terrace
description: An open area connected to a bar, restaurant, etc., serving as an outdoor sitting area for clients (edintcom:Terrace, subclass of edint-infraestructura's Facility).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Terrace'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Point providing the geographical position of the entity.

coordinates.description: Property. Coordinates of the Point, in WGS84 [longitude, latitude] order.

identifier.description: Property. A human-readable code identifying the terrace in the source data (dct:identifier), e.g. 'TER-0001'.

belongsTo.description: Relationship. Territorial unit (e.g. city district / 'Barrio') the terrace belongs to. Inherited from Facility (edint-infraestructura).

infrastructureType.description: Relationship. Reference to a concept of edint-infraestructura's InfrastructureType controlled vocabulary, e.g. Terrace. Inherited from Facility.

floorSize.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/floorSize'. The terrace's floor area, e.g. in square meters.

maximumAttendeeCapacity.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/maximumAttendeeCapacity'. The maximum number of people the terrace can accommodate.

hasTerracePeriod.description: Property. The period during which the terrace operates, from the TerracePeriod controlled vocabulary (edintcom:hasTerracePeriod): yearly or seasonal.

numberOfPermitedTables.description: Property. Maximum number of tables the terrace is authorized to have (edintcom:numberOfPermitedTables in the source ontology; NOTE the source's own real example data uses a different, Spanish property name -- 'numeroMesasAutorizadas' -- for this same concept instead. Modeled here under the ontology's own declared English name; see standard-metadata.yaml for the discrepancy).

numberOfPermitedChairs.description: Property. Maximum number of chairs the terrace is authorized to have (edintcom:numberOfPermitedChairs in the source ontology; same real-example naming discrepancy as numberOfPermitedTables -- the example uses 'numeroSillasAutorizadas' instead).
